_comment: A situation rather than a battle: the sides say what ground they hold and what winning
means, and the ships are whatever fleets the players bring. Sides marked bringYourOwn
wait for a saved fleet; everything else here applies to them once they arrive.
Nothing fixes the terrain, so the host chooses it when the battle is assembled. A
situation whose ground is measured from something - see nivram_assault - names its own.
name: Border Patrol
description: Two patrols meet along a disputed frontier. Neither side was looking for a battle, and neither is willing to be the one that turned away.

victoryConditions.notes: Standard Victory Conditions (S2.20). Both sides buy to the same point total, so the result is simply which patrol gave the better account of itself.

specialRules: Each side brings a fleet built to the agreed point total under the patrol scenario rules (S8.0).
Terrain is chosen by the host before the fleets are committed (S8.15).
